meta.name: battle-card-builder
meta.description: Research and draft a competitive battle card from public evidence — every claim labeled and sourced. Use when a rep needs a field-action card, not a research report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速生成带来源标注的竞争分析卡片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果销售团队需要快速获取可验证的竞争情报。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly draft competitive battle cards with sourced claims.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your sales team needs fast, verifiable competitive intelligence.

howto.what: 启用后，给出你的产品和某个对手，Claude 会查公开资料并生成「竞争战斗卡」；每条说法都标来源、日期并分为事实/推断/假设，含现场话术、陷阱问题、对方强项、定价概览和「别说」清单。
howto.when: 当你说出「做一张我们 vs 某竞品的 battle card」等请求时触发；典型用途是销售代表需要现场能用的行动卡，而不是研究报告。

say.text: 把会话里已有的竞争快照，按模板生成带来源标注的战斗卡。
say.note: 利用现有快照，只补查缺口和过期信息。

say.text: 针对第二个竞品，按同样的格式再做一张战斗卡。
say.note: 最终步骤里的选项之一，会复用格式和调查流程。

howto.what_en: Make a battle card from public evidence for your product vs one competitor. Label every claim Fact/Inference/Assumption with source+date. Fits a rep's 30-sec read: say-this, ask-this, watch-outs, pricing, don't-say.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a competitive battle card, typically naming their product and a competitor. It is for a rep who needs a field-action card, not a research report.

say_en.text: Build a battle card: our product vs [Competitor A], mid-market ops buyers.
say_en.note: Asks up to 3 questions if needed, then researches.

say_en.text: Turn the existing competitive snapshot in session into a sourced battle card.
say_en.note: Uses existing evidence; searches only gaps and stale items.

say_en.text: Build a battle card for a second competitor, same format and source standards.
say_en.note: A final-step option; reuses the same format and workflow.
